note: Shower inputs are not in Git. Regenerate with CORSIKA 7.8010 from the cards, or copy them to inputs/; checked by sha256. Each shower file needs its CORSIKA log as <name>.corsika.log (wavelength band for the atmosphere case). The curved and flat 65 deg, 75, 80 and 85 deg files (curved and flat CORSIKA binaries, see obdeect_validation.adapters.curved_showers) have sha256 null until generated; generation command: python -m obdeect_validation.adapters.curved_showers run --geometry curved|flat --zenith ZENITH --energy-min LO --energy-max HI --root WORKDIR, then copy WORKDIR/<name>.iact and WORKDIR/<name>.corsika.log to inputs/ and set the sha256 (null until generated).
